request.spec:
Show a rate calendar: for each grade and each month of the sheet's today's calendar year, the
rate in force on the first day of that month (n/a when none).
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Show a rate calendar: for each grade and each month of the sheet's today's calendar year, the
rate in force on the first day of that month (n/a when none).

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The rate calendar is in place and all 4 tests in `bin/e2e` pass.

It's a new table in the rates panel, `src/main/frontend/features/rates/rates.slot.tsx`. There's one row per grade and one column per month of the year the sheet's today falls in. Each cell is labelled `rate-month-<grade>-<yyyy-mm>` and shows the rate in force on the 1st of that month, or `n/a` if there is none.

Each cell is worked out the same way as the existing "rate today" column, just using the first of the month instead of today. So the two always agree: a rate's end date, a rate with no start date, and rates passed down from a parent sheet are all handled alike.

Only the front end changed. The data and server already had everything the calendar needs, and showing it writes no audit records. While the sheet's today is still loading, the table has no month columns yet.
